name: @siteborne/protocol-mcp
description: Credential-independent MCP 2026-07-28 protocol and Hono transport foundation for SITEBORNE utilities

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js='import { createRequire as __createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.tdqs:lint: node scripts/export-tdqs-tools.mjs /tmp/siteborne-tdqs-v1.2-tools-list.json && npx -y mcp-tdqs@0.1.0 lint --file /tmp/siteborne-tdqs-v1.2-tools-list.json --server-name net.siteborne/utility --fail-on error
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:property && pnpm run spec:verify
